stories.title: Proteste: Eklat bei Netanjahus UN-Rede – Diplomaten verlassen den Saal

en.title: Protests: Uproar at Netanyahu's UN speech – diplomats leave the hall
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu faced criticism at the UN in New York, where he defended his government's policies following accusations raised by Palestinian President Abbas.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Kanadas Hauptstadt Ottawa will „Trump Avenue“ umbenennen

en.title: USA under Trump: Canada's capital Ottawa wants to rename "Trump Avenue"
en.summary: Ottawa's city council is considering renaming Trump Avenue as tensions persist between Canada and the United States under the Trump administration.

stories.title: Kanada: Stadtrat von Ottawa streicht Trump-Avenue aus dem Stadtplan

en.title: Canada: Ottawa city council removes Trump Avenue from city map
en.summary: Ottawa's city council has removed Trump Avenue from its official map in response to neighborhood tensions with the United States.

stories.title: Nations League: Klopp-Einstand mit Enthusiasmus, Fehlern und Remis in den Niederlanden

en.title: Nations League: Klopp's debut with enthusiasm, mistakes and draw in the Netherlands
en.summary: Jürgen Klopp's first match as Germany coach appeared heading toward victory until the Netherlands equalized in stoppage time against an enthusiastic but error-prone German team.

stories.title: Netanjahu-Rede bei UN - Dutzende Diplomaten verlassen Saal

en.title: Netanyahu speech at UN - Dozens of diplomats leave hall
en.summary: Dozens of diplomats walked out when Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu took the podium at the United Nations. Netanyahu responded sharply and defended military operations in the Middle East.

stories.title: Nations League: Deutschland remis gegen Niederlande bei Debüt von Jürgen Klopp

en.title: Nations League: Germany draws with Netherlands in Jürgen Klopp's debut
en.summary: Germany came close to defeating the Netherlands through effort and commitment in Klopp's first match, but the Dutch equalized with a late cross, earning praise from Klopp.

stories.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: Etliche Delegierte verlassen vor Rede bei der Uno-Vollversammlung den Saal

en.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: Several Delegates Leave Hall Before Speech at UN General Assembly
en.summary: Dozens of delegates walked out during Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the UN General Assembly to protest Israel's actions in Gaza. Netanyahu responded with sharp criticism of the protesters, particularly targeting New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

stories.title: Problematischer Name: Rennpferd muss wegen Hitler-Bezug umbenannt werden

en.title: Problematic Name: Racehorse Must Be Renamed Due to Hitler Reference
en.summary: A horse owner and breeder has named a racehorse with references to Hitler, including names such as "Austrian Painter" and "My Struggle". A formal complaint has been filed against the owner.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Xi Jinping besucht Weißes Haus und kündigt Panda-Geschenk an

en.title: Donald Trump: Xi Jinping visits White House and announces panda gift
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping visited the White House with gifts, including two pandas destined for Atlanta Zoo, while both leaders emphasized harmonious relations and discussed artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Rheinland-Pfalz behält MPK-Vorsitz - Sachsen-Anhalt wird übersprungen

en.title: Rhineland-Palatinate retains MPK chairmanship - Saxony-Anhalt is skipped
en.summary: The 16 state leaders agreed that Rhineland-Palatinate will hold the chairmanship of the Minister-President Conference for another year, resulting in Saxony-Anhalt being skipped in the regular rotation.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Land verzichtet nach AfD-Wahlsieg auf MPK-Vorsitz

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: State forfeits MPK chairmanship following AfD election victory
en.summary: Saxony-Anhalt has declined to assume its scheduled turn as chair of the Minister-President Conference due to the AfD's electoral success, while the remainder of the rotation sequence remains unchanged.

stories.title: Nach Richterspruch - Weißes Haus lässt CNN-Reporter wieder zu

en.title: Following court ruling - White House allows CNN reporter access again
en.summary: President Trump had barred CNN and other media outlets from access for several days, but the White House ultimately granted reporters entry following a judicial decision.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Konfrontiert mit Protest – Netanjahu verteidigt Kriege bei UN

en.title: +++ Iran war +++: Confronted with protest - Netanyahu defends wars at UN
en.summary: Several UN delegates walked out during Netanyahu's speech at the United Nations, while EU leadership called on Iran to cooperate with nuclear authorities.

stories.title: Nikkei, Yen, Hang Seng: Asiens Börsen trotzen globalem Anleihe-Ausverkauf – Nikkei im Plus

en.title: Nikkei, Yen, Hang Seng: Asia's stock exchanges defy global bond sell-off – Nikkei in positive territory
en.summary: Asian stock markets are resisting a broader global bond market decline amid rising government bond yields that raise concerns about higher borrowing costs. Currency markets are being affected by Trump's criticism of the weak yen.

stories.title: Immobilien: Es wird teuer – wer Wohnraum leer stehen lässt, muss häufig zahlen

en.title: Real estate: It's getting expensive – those who leave residential space vacant must often pay
en.summary: Cities and municipalities are increasingly taking action against property owners who leave rental apartments vacant. Authorities are imposing penalties on unused residential properties in various jurisdictions.

stories.title: Argentinien: Das Schuldenproblem der Argentinier nährt den Zorn auf Milei

en.title: Argentina: The debt problem of Argentines fuels anger at Milei
en.summary: Many Argentines are borrowing to cover basic living expenses, but a growing number struggle to repay these debts. Rising household indebtedness could become a political challenge for the president.

stories.title: Gastkommentar: Chinas wirtschaftlicher Erfolg ist teuer erkauft

en.title: Guest commentary: China's economic success comes at a high cost
en.summary: Beijing's industrial policy has achieved success in key technologies, though China-experts suggest only certain aspects of this approach could serve as a model for Germany.
